sexquitertia.definition: A superparticular ratio in which the greater term contains the lesser once plus its third (e.g., 8 : 6 = 4 : 3, the musical fourth and the ratio of a single face of the tetrahedron to a single face of the octahedron in the same sphere).

simetria.definition: Defined after Vitruvius I.2 and III.1 as the harmonious agreement of the members of a work among themselves and of the individual parts to the whole universe of the figure according to a fixed module (Architectura Cap. I–IV).
